name: design-system-tokens-for-colors
hook: Always use CSS variables from globals.css for semantic colors
body:
All colors must use CSS variables defined in globals.css or Tailwind utility classes. Hardcoded hex/rgba values violate the design-system-first mandate.

Mapping used in this fix:
- `#f3f4f6` → `bg-gray-100`
- `#f9fafb` → `bg-gray-50`
- `#e5e7eb` → `bg-gray-200`
- `#0ea5e9` → `var(--accent-sky)`
- `#a855f7` → `var(--accent-purple)`
- `#0284c7` → `var(--accent-sky-deep)`
- `#9333ea` → `var(--accent-purple-deep)`
- `#111827` → `bg-gray-900`
- `#f59e0b` → Tailwind amber-500/text-amber-600
- `#22c55e` → Tailwind green-500/text-green-500

Why: Hardcoded hex values bypass the design token system, making theme changes and dark mode support impossible.

How to apply: When adding colors to any component, check globals.css for existing CSS variables first, then Tailwind tokens. Only create new tokens when no existing token fits.
why: The project has a design-system-first mandate documented in CLAUDE.md. All colors must flow through CSS variables in globals.css or Tailwind classes.
